title: Grilled Apricot Skewers with Crunchy Thai Sauce
description: Sweet and savory apricot skewers marinated in a zesty Thai-inspired sauce, then grilled to perfection. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Thai sauce, kissed honey, and crunchy peanuts.
Add the apricot pieces to the marinade and toss to coat.
Soak bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Thread apricot pieces onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side, or until lightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with additional crunchy peanuts if desired.
